'''Brong''' was a [[Shi'ido]] who served the [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Vont]] as her [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]]. He protected the [[Gender/Legends|woman's]] belongings from the prospective [[Thief/Legends|thieves]] [[Sammie Staable]] and [[Smileredon-Verdont]],<ref name="CSWE" /> both of whom were active in the [[Time/Legends|time]] surrounding the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Date">In {{Blog|pablog|50|Rookies: Rendezvous -- Week Three Annotations}}, author [[Pablo Hidalgo]] states that ''[[Rookies: Rendezvous]]'', which features the first appearances of [[Sammie Staable]] and [[Smileredon-Verdont]], is set around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which the ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Brong was first mentioned in the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Stephen J. Sansweet]].<ref name="CSWE" />
